title: Static meal-plan publication metadata
description: The root value is either the stable index file or one immutable publication manifest. Paths are relative to the file containing them; semantic validation checks publication and plan identity against path segments.

manifest_path.description: Relative to this index file; the publication directory must match publication_id.

exported_at.description: Time the validated artifact was finalized, before upload or Pages deployment. It does not assert deployment success.

selected_months.description: Explicitly selected calendar months in YYYY-MM form.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for the published meal dates.

plans.description: Current plans overlapping selected_months, including complete weeks that cross a month boundary. Empty means no saved plans were available for the selected months.

shopping_trips.description: Shopping trips whose every week is in plans, sorted by trip_id. Empty means no trip was published.

path.description: Relative to this immutable manifest: exactly shopping-trips/<trip_id>.json. The file validates against OpenAPI's ShoppingTrip schema.

plan_path.description: Relative to this immutable manifest. The directory segment must equal summary.plan_id.

shopping_path.description: Relative to this immutable manifest. The directory segment must equal summary.plan_id.
